question: What rate would I get on a 500k loan with a 20% deposit?
reply:
A 20% deposit means an LVR of 80%, which falls in the "60.01% to 80%" band.

Example Lender's page (read 13 Oct 2026, 12:00pm Perth time) shows for that band, variable, owner occupier, principal and interest: interest rate 6.14% p.a., comparison rate 6.17% p.a., monthly fee $0.

Note: this is only what Example Lender's own page shows and isn't a rate for a specific loan amount — it's the band rate regardless of loan size. Since this was read today, it should still be current, but worth rechecking the page if you're using this later.
